sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे द्वाविंशत्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १२२ ।।
transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe dvāviṁśatyuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 122 ।।

translations.english: Having admonished the two glowing sons, and Sita, Dasaratha went by aerial car to the world of Indra.
